newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Dominicks taps BT, Chase for $325 million loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Dominicks taps BT, Chase for $325 million loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, September 5 (LPC) - Dominicks Supermarkets mandated Bankers Trust New York Corp and Chase Manhattan Corp for a $325 million bank loan, banking sources said.
The loan will replace higher-priced bank debt the company undertook during its leveraged buyout in March 1995, they said.

The 6.5-year credit is will be split between a $100 million amortizing term loan and a $225 million revolving credit, each priced at 150 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), according to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing.

The March 1995 deal was split between a $100 million revolver and about $280 million of loans targeted at institutional investors. The existing loans bear interest at 275 to 400 basis points over LIBOR, bankers said.
The institutional loans are sold to non-bank investors, such as prime rate funds and insurance companies.

The move by Dominicks to replace institutional bank loans with lower-priced credits is part of an overall trend in a market that has seen pricing drop consistently across the credit spectrum, according to several lenders.

Also, the deal, which comes in conjunction with an initial public offering, is another example of a leveraged buyout entity returning to the public market in a short time period, lenders said. Many companies now complete that process in fewer than 18 months, much sooner than had been seen in the past, according to lenders.
Dominicks, based in Northlake, Illinois, was acquired by Yucaipa Cos in the 1995 LBO.
